## Summary

Describe the purpose and scope of this change.

## Type of change

- [ ] New skill or capability
- [ ] Legal-source or citation correction
- [ ] Documentation improvement
- [ ] Governance or security improvement
- [ ] Template or taxonomy change
- [ ] Breaking workflow or schema change

## Related issue

Closes #

## Validation performed

Describe source verification, link checks, Markdown review, tests, or manual validation.

## Legal and evidence review

- [ ] Material legal propositions identify traceable sources.
- [ ] Source text, paraphrase, inference, and recommendation are clearly distinguished.
- [ ] Current law was verified where required.
- [ ] No judgment number, section, holding, or factual claim was invented.
- [ ] Human legal review is required or documented for high-risk output.

## Security, privacy, and copyright

- [ ] No credentials, tokens, or secrets are included.
- [ ] No unredacted personal, employee, medical, payroll, disciplinary, or confidential legal data is included.
- [ ] Third-party content and licensing were checked.
- [ ] Quotations and reproductions remain within lawful limits.

## Compatibility and documentation

- [ ] Existing file contracts and workflows remain compatible.
- [ ] Breaking changes include migration guidance.
- [ ] README or related documentation was updated.
- [ ] CHANGELOG.md was updated for a material change.

## Reviewer notes

List known limitations, unresolved questions, or areas requiring specialist review.
